history.summary: CSV row 'Sai Baba Temple, Panaji, Goa' — CSV TOWN CORRECTED: the most prominent Sai Baba shrine in the Panaji area is the Sai Baba Temple at St Estevan (island village in Tiswadi taluka, North Goa, listed at Borim, Tamsheri, St Estevan, PIN 403106), about 5-7 km from Panaji. IDENTITY PROVISIONAL: no dedicated published history found for this shrine; a directory listing rates it 4.7 with 1,100+ ratings as a local Sai shrine. It must not be confused with the separate Sai Baba Temple at Borim on the Margao-Ponda highway (Ponda taluka). Coordinates are approximate and corroborated only from a social-location listing (identity unverified).

name: Sai Baba Temple
town_description: St Estevan (Santo Estêvão) is a small island village in Tiswadi taluka, North Goa, a few kilometres from Panaji in the Mandovi river. It is one of Goa's quiet traditional river islands, known for the 1759 Church of St Estevam and its old Goan village lanes. Despite its Catholic heritage character, it hosts local Hindu shrines including the Sai Baba temple.
